title: fix(drilling): Break-through follow-ups - the note, an idle selector, a full-diameter post case
body:
## What changed

This PR does the five items of #2528 (follow-ups of #2504).

1. **The Break-through note agrees with the field.** A Drill measured from its full diameter said "through holes run 2.803 mm past the part bottom (Break-through)" for a 1 mm Break-through. The note now says "through holes run 2.803 mm past the part bottom (Break-through 1.000 mm from the full diameter, plus the 1.803 mm drill point), the deepest to Z-2.803". `break_through::Broke` carries the point length (`with_point`). The Tip case, Bore and Thread keep "(Break-through)". The words "run X past the part bottom" stay, so readers of the note keep working.
2. **The "Break-through from" selector is disabled where it has no effect.** `holes_page::break_through_from_idle` gives the reason, in the generator's order:
   - a lathe's axial drill (it always measures to the tip);
   - a stated Bottom;
   - no through hole in the list;
   - a Spot, Tap, Floating tap or Ream cycle;
   - a tool with no point cone for this cycle (review fix, commit 15626f333). The page asks the generator's own rule, `drilling::through_tip_run` from the full diameter with no allowance, for the selected tool. A zero point disables the choice: for example Auto with a tap, a boring bar or an end mill, or a 180 degree drill. An unknown tool or a refused tip angle keeps the choice live.

   The combo is disabled. The reason shows when the user hovers the row (`on_disabled_hover_text`, the pattern of `fixture_menu.rs` and `feeds_page.rs`). A disabled widget shows no plain hover text, so the normal hint is used only while the row is enabled. I chose "disable" over "hide": a hidden row reads as a missing feature.
3. **A correction to the #2441 decision entry.** Issue branches do not edit `RECOMMENDED.md`, so `docs/decisions/2528-drill-point-followups.md` records the correction:
   - PR #2504 did not keep the examples byte-identical. It rebuilt the catalog case `2d/first-part` (`G73 ... Z-1. Q18.` to `G83 ... Z-2.803 Q6.`) and `examples/first-router-part.camproj` (v62 to v68, `full_diameter`, depth -1.0 to -2.802582). Only `examples/first-part.camproj` stayed the same.
   - An MCP or script patch does not default to `FullDiameter`. `add_operation` starts from the seed (`FullDiameter`). `edit_operation` applies a JSON merge patch over the stored parameters, so an omitted `break_through_from` keeps the stored value.
4. **Three file splits, structure only.** The `#[test]` counts do not change (app lib 322, motion lib 777 before item 1).
   - `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` (469 lines): the program plan moves to `stock_sim_plan.rs` (225 + 256 lines).
   - `crates/app/src/stock_play.rs` (409 lines): `PlayIndex` and `PlaySeed` move to `stock_play_index.rs` (330 + 93 lines). Their fields become `pub(super)`, because `FieldPlay` and `stock_play_head` read them.
   - `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests.rs` (508 lines): the five recognition tests move to `tests_recognize.rs` (404 + 110 lines). The shared helpers stay, so the other test modules keep their imports.
5. **Every post records a full-diameter through hole.** A new recorded stream `drill_full_diameter` (one 10 mm through hole, the default Full diameter, tip at Z-12.803) joins `recorded::CASES` and the `post_suite!` macro. Its generator guard is `recorded_post_streams::drill_full_diameter_stream_is_current`. The 15 mill posts record a program with `Z-12.803`. LinuxCNC and Heidenhain Klartext refuse the machine-less case by name, as they refuse `drill_retract`. Review fix (commit 2acc52c3e): LinuxCNC also posts the case on `assets/machines/vmc.mch`, and the NC golden `linuxcnc/drill_full_diameter_on_machine.nc` records `G73 X20 Y10 Z-12.803 R1 Q4 F60`. The guard `recorded_streams::each_drilling_post_records_the_full_diameter_depth` requires an NC golden with 12.803 from each post with a mill drilling cycle. Klartext is a named gap (`recorded::DRILL_DEPTH_GAP`): it refuses a tool with no stated kind, and the stream states none. Follow-up: #4461. The lathe, wire, sinker, plasma and waterjet posts keep their named refusals.

## Goldens moved

None. Item 5 adds 28 new goldens and one stream: the 27 `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/<post>/drill_full_diameter.{nc,refusal}` and `linuxcnc/drill_full_diameter_on_machine.nc`. No existing `.nc` golden changes. After the merge of #4382, the new goldens `fanuc/drill_full_diameter.nc` and `doosan-dnm/drill_full_diameter.nc` were written again with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`; only their preamble line changed (`G17` and `G94`).

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-motion` lib: `break_through::tests::a_full_diameter_drill_names_the_field_and_its_point`.
- `camcraft-app` `break_through`: `the_default_is_today_s_millimetre_and_is_said` (the note names 1.000 mm and the 1.803 mm point for the Full-diameter drill, and "(Break-through)" for Tip and Bore).
- `camcraft-ui` lib: `holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_is_disabled_where_it_has_no_effect` (the four reasons; the combo is disabled until a hole is through; a hover over the disabled row paints the reason, and a hover over the enabled row paints the normal hint). `drill_break_through_from_defaults_to_full_diameter_and_switches_to_tip` now gives the draft a through hole first.
- `camcraft-ui` lib (review fix): `holes_break_through::drill_break_through_from_is_idle_for_a_tool_without_a_point` and `drill_break_through_from_page_disables_a_tap_and_a_flat_drill_on_auto`. Mutation: without the tool rule, both fail; restored, both pass.
- `camcraft-post` (review fix): `script_linuxcnc::drill_full_diameter_on_a_machine_posts_the_full_diameter_depth` and `recorded_streams::each_drilling_post_records_the_full_diameter_depth`. Mutation: stream depth Z -12803 to -11000 makes the LinuxCNC machine test fail; a hidden machine golden makes the guard fail. Restored, both pass.
- `camcraft-app` `recorded_post_streams`: `drill_full_diameter_stream_is_current`.
- `camcraft-post` `script_*`: `drill_full_diameter` in each of the 27 post suites.

## Readings

Review-fix round on 99e972d30 (blockers of the review of 2acc52c3e):

- `b408bbed4` merges `upstream/main`, with no conflicts. `99e972d30` writes the two goldens again and makes `drill_break_through_from_is_disabled_where_it_has_no_effect` hover the Label node (`get_by_role_and_label(Role::Label, ..)`). Since cf3565107 the controls of a row carry the row label as their name, so `get_by_label` can find the combo.
- Quick gate on 99e972d30 (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 261 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 60.6 min. The site tests step was skipped (`zola` is not installed on this machine). That is not a pass, and this round does not change `site/`.
- `script_goldens`: 469 passed. `camcraft-ui --lib holes_break_through`: 6 passed.

Review-fix round on 2acc52c3e (the author's commits are kept; no rebase):

- Quick gate (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, clean target): 393 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 40.3 min. UI lib 1763 passed, 8 ignored. `script_linuxcnc` 13 passed. `recorded_streams` 13 passed. `example_catalog` 44 passed, 4 ignored.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: not run in this round. The round changes UI code and post tests only. The PR is P7, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" requires no heavy step.

Earlier readings (author, on 31438caa1):

- Quick gate on 31438caa1 (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 393 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 49.5 min.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-post -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post` after the merge of `upstream/main` (with #4367): all pass, and no golden changes.
- `#[test]` counts before and after the splits: app lib 322, motion lib 777.
- Heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`) on 31438caa1: 115 steps (1 build, 41 `motion`, 73 `app`), 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 73.0 min. The known fails #1950 (3) and #2849 (1) are red as expected.

## Screenshots

The Levels group on the Heights tab of a Drill operation. The tool, cycle (Auto), hole list (one through hole) and pointer position are the same in each pair. "Before" is `upstream/main`; "after" is this PR.

| Tool | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| TAP-M6, Auto | ![before tap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/77e36f49c61726c0fb0cd66d8a0875964487af19/4380/before-tap-auto.png) | ![after tap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/77e36f49c61726c0fb0cd66d8a0875964487af19/4380/after-tap-auto.png) |
| DR-0400, Auto | ![before drill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/77e36f49c61726c0fb0cd66d8a0875964487af19/4380/before-drill-auto.png) | ![after drill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/77e36f49c61726c0fb0cd66d8a0875964487af19/4380/after-drill-auto.png) |

Before, the choice is live for a tap and shows the normal hint. After, it is disabled, and the hover says "no effect: this tool has no point cone, so its tip run is the same". A twist drill keeps the choice live in both.

The author's first pair (no through hole, then a through hole):
![disabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sn3ro/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/2528/bt-from-disabled.png) ![enabled](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sn3ro/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/2528/bt-from-enabled.png)

## Not exercised

- A real machine.

Changelog: Drill: the Break-through note names the field's value and the drill point apart for a full-diameter drill. The "Break-through from" choice is disabled, with the reason, where it has no effect (lathe axial drill, stated Bottom, no through hole, spot/tap/ream cycles, a tool with no point cone).

Fixes #2528
